description: The offence details for a defendant on a case and the offence results rendered in a NOW document

welshLegislation.description: The legislation for the offence in Welsh language

civilOffence.description: Indicates that the offence is a civil matter rather than a criminal one

dvlaCode.description: The dvla code for the offence e.g. SP50

startDate.description: The start date of the offence

endDate.description: The end date of the offence

displayText.description: The formatted offence details.  string.Format('{0}{1}{2}{1}{3}', title, Environment.NewLine, legislation, wording)

convictionDate.description: Indicates that prosecution of this offence has led to a criminal conviction.  Not relevant for civil cases

convictingCourtCode.description: Indicates the code of Convicting court when that prosecution of this offence has led to a criminal conviction. Not relevant for civil cases

convictionStatus.description: Indicates the status of a conviction.  Null when offence is civil.  Not Convicted when there is not a conviction date.  Otherwise Convicted

plea.description: The plea entered against the offence

vehicleRegistration.description: The vehicle registration relevant to the offence
